Emma / team —

Quick notes from the marketplace enablement side (we onboard listings across AWS/Azure/GCP so I’ll keep it pragmatic):
- SKU mapping: make sure we have one canonical internal SKU per co-sell bundle. Don’t mirror Nimble internal SKUs verbatim in the catalog — use a joint SKU alias to prevent drift.
- Entitlement checks: two options — token validation (preferred for per-seat licenses) or HubSpot deal-level flag for account-level entitlements (used for long-term managed customers). If Nimble prefers tokens, we’ll need a small webhook endpoint to validate tokens at purchase time.
- Compliance checklist: Azure requires marketplace certification screenshots (publisher verification) and a liability/indemnity addendum in the offer. I attached a short playbook template (redwood-nimble-joint-playbook-v1.docx) with the checklist.

Attachments: redwood-nimble-joint-playbook-v1.docx

Action items:
1) Emma — confirm whether Nimble will issue tokens or use deal flags by 11/09
2) Rachel / Ben — prepare joint SKU alias list and sales one-pager by 11/11
3) Ops/legal — exchange example marketplace terms (Emma to introduce Sarah)

Thanks,
